title: Dictionary of Applied Machine Learning — companion software: term demos, the mldict LaTeX package, and an MCP server

creators.name: Jung, Alexander
creators.affiliation: Department of Computer Science, Aalto University, Finland

description: Companion software for the openly licensed course edition of the Dictionary of Applied Machine Learning. Three components: one self-contained Python demo per dictionary term, each recomputing what its entry states and printing one line per check, published as Jupyter notebooks that open in Colab; mldict, the LaTeX package carrying the book's notation macros so the same symbols can be used elsewhere; and an MCP server that exposes the dictionary to AI assistants by reading the site's terms.json. The dictionary itself is archived separately under concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21569296.
